items.question: Customer behavior has changed. Speed matters.
items.answer: Today’s car shopper expects a fast response and a clear reason to stay engaged. A missed message or slow follow-up can cost your store the opportunity.

items.question: Marketing should move people to action.

items.question: Better engagement supports better results.
items.answer: When communication improves, appointment flow improves. And when appointment flow improves, your sales team has more real opportunities to sell.
